introHtml: Igloo tote bags combine the trusted durability of a legendary cooler brand with the versatility of a branded carryall. From the Repreve Tote Cooler made with recycled materials to the Daytripper Dual Compartment Tote Cooler with separate dry and insulated zones, these bags keep contents cold while advertising your logo. Ideal for outdoor events, employee appreciation, or client gifts, they offer multiple decoration options including screen printing and embroidery. Choose custom Igloo tote bags for a functional giveaway that stands up to real use.
